description: Break-even occupancy of a rental: the share of scheduled rent needed to pay operating expenses and debt service, and the cushion left above it. Over 100% means the property cannot cover its costs even fully rented. The common mistake is measuring against collected rent instead of scheduled rent, which hides the vacancy the figure exists to show. Send gross_rent_annual (scheduled rent at full occupancy), operating_expenses_annual and, when there is a loan, annual_debt_service; with no debt service the figure covers operating expenses only.

annual_debt_service.description: Principal and interest per year, e.g. 12000 (0 for no loan)

gross_rent_annual.description: Scheduled rent per year at full occupancy, e.g. 36000

name: compute_break_even_occupancy
title: Break-even occupancy
